subject: Skylark MAP: Q3 expansion & add-ons onboarding

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop, kimberly_park, neha_kapoor
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Skylark MAP: Q3 expansion & add-ons onboarding

Hi all —

This is the weekly MAP checkpoint for the Q3 expansion we discussed. Short update below and a focused list of open actions so owners can confirm timelines before our next executive sync.

Status summary:
- Expansion intent: confirmed (Skylark Product + Platform teams) — target go-live for add-ons: early September.
- Current blockers: procurement SOW sign + capacity reservation for peak onboarding traffic.
- Usage growth signal: staging tests show +35% token volume with two pilot teams.

Key meeting notes (7/3 onboarding call):
- Product wants feature-flagged rollout to 3 teams, then ramp to org-wide over 6 weeks.
- Platform requested dedicated burst capacity for first 2 weeks of ramp.
- Procurement asked to receive final SOW and invoice schedule by 7/10.

Action items (owners & target):
1) Finalize SOW and invoice schedule — Owner: Sean Gallagher — Target: 2026-07-10 (attachment: SOW_SKY-2026-07.pdf)
2) Capacity reservation (burst pool + autoscale thresholds) — Owner: Kimberly Park — Target: 2026-07-12 (attachment: capacity-projection_SKY.csv)
3) Add-ons config and onboarding runbook — Owner: Lauren Bishop — Target: 2026-07-16 (attachment: Skylark_MAP_Q3_addons_v2.xlsx)
4) Procurement checklist & PO timeline confirmation — Owner: Ben Thomas / procurement@skylark.so — Target: 2026-07-09

Risks / asks:
- If procurement pushes the PO past 7/15 we will not meet the early-September go-live without compressing the onboarding window.
- Please confirm owners above or reply with suggested changes.

Next steps:
- I’ll upload the SOW and updated MAP workbook to the shared Drive after edits.
- Tentative executive checkpoint scheduled: 2026-07-21 (will confirm availability).

Thanks — please reply with brief confirmations so we can keep the MAP timeline tight.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0127

Sean / team —

Thanks for the clear MAP note. Quick confirmations from Skylark: 
- Procurement expects to return a signed SOW by 2026-07-09; we are expediting internally.
- We agree to the proposed Day 0 checklist and the slightly later trial start (Aug 22) — this helps our infra team finalize traffic shaping.
- For capacity, our platform lead (Ari) will work with Kimberly on the projected burst numbers; Ari will send an initial target by 7/10.

A couple of asks on our side:
- Can Redwood provide a brief runbook excerpt that we can include in our internal onboarding doc? (1 page)
- Please confirm billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and when invoice will be issued after SOW sign.

I’ll loop procurement separately if we need a formal PO template.
